PLT.TENANT_PROVISIONED.description: A tenant (state, private provider, network) is provisioned

GOV.SCOPE_CHANGED.description: Hierarchy node created, moved or closed (closure table rebuilt)

GOV.CONFIG_PUBLISHED.description: A configuration layer section is published

GOV.POLICY_PUBLISHED.description: A rule version is published after its tests pass

IAM.USER_DEACTIVATED.description: Account deactivated (e.g. HR leaving date) — workspace channels removed

INS.APPLICATION_SUBMITTED.description: Institution registration or approval application submitted

INS.STATUS_CHANGED.description: Institution lifecycle or onboarding status changed

INS.LICENCE_EXPIRED.description: Licence passed expiry (issuance and new entries blocked)

INSP.FINDING_RECORDED.description: Finding saved in the inspection workspace

PVT.SANCTION_APPLIED.description: Sanction step takes effect (admissions/exam entries blocked)

LRN.LEFT.description: Leaver recorded (unknown destination at compulsory age → CME referral)

FAM.CONSENT_CHANGED.description: Consent given, refused or withdrawn (propagates immediately)

STF.AUTHORISATION_CHANGED.description: Authorisation added, verified or expired (G3 re-check)

PAY.RUN_APPROVED.description: Pay run approved by two people

ACA.SUBJECT_PLAN_PUBLISHED.description: Class subject plan published (course spaces created)

CUR.PUBLISHED.description: Version published (adoption resolved, schemes redrafted, G10)

CUR.ADOPTION_RESOLVED.description: Applicable version stamped for an institution and level

CUR.ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED.description: Teacher of record or co-teacher changed (G2/G3)

ATT.REGISTER_MISSING.description: Register not taken by deadline (Register Agent)

CERT.REISSUED.description: Reissue issued; original superseded at the same moment

SAF.CONCERN_RAISED.description: Concern recorded — notification carries no detail

SAF.STAFF_CASE_OPENED.description: Staff case opened — designated officer notified without detail

SEN.ADJUSTMENT_CHANGED.description: Authorised adjustment changed (rooms, exams, assignments re-checked)

LMS.ASSIGNMENT_PUBLISHED.description: Assignment published to learners and parents

DOC.INGESTED.description: Document stored (search indexed unless special category)

BIL.INVOICE_OVERDUE.description: Invoice overdue (Fee Agent; never restricts education)

SUB.STATEMENT_SIGNED.description: Statement signed by state or operator

AGT.LEVEL_LOWERED.description: Error threshold breached (autonomy lowered one level)

HR.POSITION_CHANGED.description: Establishment position approved, frozen or abolished

HR.POSTING_APPROVED.description: Posting order approved (sending institution prepares handover — G9)

HR.POSTING_EFFECTIVE.description: Posting took effect: old post ended, new post filled, grants moved

HR.LEAVE_APPROVED.description: Leave approved — staff absence created and cover started (G8)

HR.SEPARATION_RECORDED.description: Staff member separated from a post (access ends, classes reassigned)

HR.BANK_ACCOUNT_CHANGED.description: Salary account changed after call-back and second approval (staff member notified)

HR.INTEGRITY_FLAG_RAISED.description: Payroll integrity scan raised a flag

HR.PAYROLL_HOLD_DECIDED.description: A person decided to hold or release pay on a flag

FCL.OBLIGATION_PUBLISHED.description: Creditor published or reconfirmed an obligation

FCL.OBLIGATION_SETTLED.description: Obligation settled, waived, written off, withdrawn or expired

FCL.CHECK_PERFORMED.description: Clearance check run; each creditor and the family are notified

FCL.DECISION_RECORDED.description: Admission decision recorded on a clearance check

FCL.DISPUTE_RAISED.description: Obligation disputed (shown as disputed until resolved)

FCL.DISPUTE_RESOLVED.description: LGA or state resolved a dispute

FCL.EXCHANGE_QUERY_RECEIVED.description: Another state queried this registry; creditor institutions of a matched learner are notified
